parts.instructions: You are a new member of the club. Fill in the form. Write in sentences. Use 20-30 words.
parts.prompt: When and where do you usually use your computer?

parts.instructions: You are communicating with other members of the club in the chat room. Reply to their questions. Write in sentences. Use 30-40 words per answer.

chatMessages.messageText: Tell me about the last time you used a computer to do something?
My grandmother doesn't know anything about computers. How can she learn, and what should she do?
Young people spend too much time using computers, and some say it's not good for them. What's your opinion?

parts.instructions: You are a member of the club. Read the notice from the club president/manager and write the requested emails.
parts.managerNotice:
“We are making some changes to the website because we want more people to join us. As you know, the website at this moment is very simple, and we would like to hear some ideas on how to make it more attractive and why you think it will attract more visitors.”
Q1: Write an email to your friend, who is also a member of our club. Tell your friend what suggestions you will make and why. Write about 50 words.
Q2: Write an email to the manager of the club. Write about your ideas and what you think about the situation. Write about 120-150 words.

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your friend who is also a member of Computer Club. Express your thoughts and feelings about the announcement and suggest what you both should do.
Write an email to the president/manager of Computer Club. Give your detailed feedback, propose constructive solutions for the initiative, and explain why your suggestions would benefit the club.
